summary: The allowance was never reached, so the probe measured nothing about enforcement. Given --max-budget-usd 0.02 and a 6000-word task, the session reported its own remaining budget back in its answer - 'the current session budget is $0.02 remaining' - declined the task as unaffordable, and exited 0 with subtype success after $0.0124. The requested exit was 1; a probe that did not reach its subject establishes nothing.
establishes: Nothing about P08. It does establish one runtime behaviour worth a freeze's attention in its own right: on 2.1.269 the dollar allowance is visible to the model as a remaining-budget figure, so a cell can reason about its ceiling and stop short of it. That is a treatment-relevant behaviour, not only an accounting one - a per-attempt ceiling is part of what every arm sees, so it must be identical across arms or it is a confound.
residual: Re-probed as P08b with an instruction not to self-limit. Both records are retained; this one is not evidence of an enforced bound.
read_from: the probe's own retained output, not asserted beside it
